Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.

components.name: Ring and bus

limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.

components.name: Add/drop ring

limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.

components.name: Racetrack resonator

Curved boundaries use 32 intervals per semicircle.

components.name: Mach–Zehnder layout

components.name: Waveguide Bragg grating

limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.

components.name: Linear grating coupler
components.summary: An access taper feeds a finite, partially etched grating aperture.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
One geometric guided input; vertical radiation is not represented as a guided port. No fibre-coupling efficiency claim.

components.name: Photonic-crystal nanobeam cavity
components.summary: Two hole arrays surround an unperforated defect region.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
Through holes are actual polygon holes with 20 vertices each. A passive cavity, not a simulated laser.

components.name: Passive DBR cavity
components.summary: Two corrugated reflector sections flank a plain guide spacer.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
Passive geometry only: no pumping, gain, threshold or light–current prediction.

components.name: Serpentine delay layout
components.summary: Parallel straight segments are joined by alternating semicircular turns.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
A geometric delay path; delay, dispersion and bend loss require a qualified simulation.

components.name: Euler bend
components.summary: Two clothoids join a straight input to a turned output.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
The radius sets the tightest curvature at the midpoint. Both ends have zero curvature.

components.name: Strip-to-slot transition
components.summary: A widening through-slot divides a strip into two finite rails.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
The drawn slot begins at a sharp tip. Fabrication bias and modal conversion require separate analysis.

components.name: 1×4 MMI splitter
components.summary: Four spaced access tapers connect one multimode body to output guides.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
The four output ports are separated physically. Their powers and phases require a multimode study.

components.name: Apodized fan grating
components.summary: Concentric shallow-etch teeth vary in duty cycle across a circular fan.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
Teeth are circular sectors. A fibre tilt, fibre mode, elliptical phase fronts and coupling efficiency require a dedicated optical design.

components.name: Tapered two-guide coupler
components.summary: Two guides exchange widths along a coupling region with fixed edge separation.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
The four access leads have constant width. Adiabaticity and transfer efficiency require mode-resolved measurements.

components.name: Photonic-crystal line defect
components.summary: A missing row through a triangular lattice forms a line defect between strip leads.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
The slab has a finite lattice with through holes. Bloch bands and transmission require separate studies.

components.name: Pulley-coupled ring
components.summary: A bus follows the ring over a user-selected wrap angle before leaving tangentially.
limitations: Editable design geometry. No electromagnetic performance is supplied.
Named ports are geometric intent, not measured or solved eigenmodes.
The coupling arc has constant nominal radial clearance. No coupling coefficient or resonance is inferred.
